::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 8th [1870]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Mrs Mercier](people/person_990.qmd)
Here is that charming little story at last.[^1]

One thing might I ask? Could not poor Maria’s one note of admiration be changed from Lor! I have rather the feeling that it is an abridgement of a more sacred word.

Did you mean Marian to blunder about feeding cows and milking chickens - ? Also did you send me a capital paper about fashion?[^2]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: The phrase 'charming little story' suggests that CMY was sending a proof for final correction, but no short stories containing Maria and Marian appeared in *MP*during the next eighteen months. A possible explanation is that Mercier was the author of a story called *Mrs Filby's Maria* which was published in Warne's Victoria Packet series, and which CMY commended in 'Hints on Reading' *MP* (April 1871) 418.  CMY was the nominal editor of the Victoria Tales and Stories.  No extant copies of *Mrs Filby's Maria* have been traced.
[^3]: Anne M., 'A Letter on Fashion' *MP* (July 1870) 99-101.
